comment: An image of a newer minor version loads (I4) unless a strict object (a rule, a schedule entry) has a member this firmware does not know: then the refusal adds that the image's schema is newer than the firmware reads (from 1.2 on). The rules are not checked once a schedule is refused (refuse-newer-minor-rule.json has the rule). The case uses minor 99, so it stays newer than every firmware.
